elements.element: Customer owns deliverables and work product created for it
elements.evidence: Client owns ... all right, title and interest in all deliverables and work product of the Support Services created for Client

elements.element: Vendor assigns such rights to Customer
elements.evidence: TrueLink hereby assigns to Client, all right, title and interest in all deliverables and work product
TrueLink retains all of its ownership and license rights in the Interface

elements.element: Licence to Vendor IP embedded in deliverables
elements.evidence: to the extent any TrueLink Intellectual Property is embedded in such deliverables, TrueLink grants Client a ... license

elements.element: Customer retains all rights in Customer Data
elements.evidence: Client retains all right, title and interest in Client's Intellectual Property and all data provided by or on behalf of Client or generated through Client's use of the Interface
No joint ownership of any intellectual property is created by this Agreement.

elements.element: Vendor owns generic tools and know-how (express)
elements.evidence: no reference to generic tools or know-how anywhere in the redlined text

elements.element: Customer licence to use, modify and sublicense deliverables
elements.evidence: licence granted is only to embedded 'TrueLink Intellectual Property ... as part of such deliverables', not to deliverables as such (Customer owns them instead)

reasons: The inserted Section 2(e) supplies every preferred atomic element: Customer ownership of deliverables and work product, an express present assignment, a perpetual/irrevocable/royalty-free licence to embedded Vendor IP, retention of Customer IP and data, and an express no-joint-ownership statement; Vendor's pre-existing IP retention survives in the untouched Section 2(d).

Fallback elements (generic tools/know-how ownership, a worldwide licence to the deliverables themselves) are not present, but that is immaterial because the preferred level is complete and the two levels are not combined.
Minimal: a single concise insertion filling a genuinely absent Customer-side ownership clause; no untouched sentence was rewritten and no new exceptions were introduced.

Intent preserved: the Section 8(d) Credit Data licence to TrueLink and TrueLink's Interface ownership remain effective, and the carve-out 'Except for the license granted in Section 8(d)' avoids contradiction between the retention of Customer data rights and that licence.
